spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (फलति)
1 To produce or bear fruit.
2 To make fruitful, to fructify.
3 To go.
(ञि, आ); ञिफला r. 1st cl. (फलति)
To divide, to cleave or split.

n. (-लं)
1 The fruit of any plant, fruit in general.
2 Fruit (metaphorically), result, produce, consequence.
3 Prosperity, flourishing, thriving.
4 Gain, profit, acquisition.
5 Recompense, reward.
6 A shield.
7 The blade of a sword or knife, the head of an arrow, &c.
8 A sort of fragrant berry and drug, commonly

Kakoli.
9

A nutmeg.
10 The three myrobalans collectively.
11 The menstrual discharge.
12 Gift, giving.
13 A ploughshare.
14 The quotient of a sum, (in arithmetic.)
15 The area of a circle, &c.
16 An equation.
17 (In astronomy,) [] The anomalistic equation of a planet.
f. (-ली)
A medicinal plant, commonly Priyangu.
m. (-लः)
A plant, (Echites antidysenterica, Rox.): see कुटज.
E.
फल to bear or produce fruit, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-लः-ली-लं)
Made of cotton, (vesture.)
m. (-लः)
1 A name of Ś

IVA.
2

A name of BALARĀMA.
n. (-लं)
The share of a plough.
E.
फल to divide, in the causal form, aff. अच्; or फल fruit, and अण् aff.

mn. (-कः-कं)
1 A shield.
2 A bench.
3 A plank.
4 A layer.
m. (-कः)
1 A bone, the os frontis, or bone of the forehead.
2 A leaf or page for writing on.
3 A plant, (Mesua ferrea.)
n. (-कं)
The buttocks.
E.
कन् added to the preceding, or फल to split or divide, aff. वुन्.

m. (-णिः)
A soldier armed with a shield.
E.
फलक, and पाणि the hand.

f. (-ना)
Desire of any consequence.
E.
फल, and कामना desiring.

mfn. (-की-किनी-कि)
Having, or being armed with a shield, &c.
m. (-की)
A sort of fish, commonly Phalāi.
E.
फलक as above, and इनि aff.

m. (-की)
A fish, caught in ponds, commonly Phalāi, (Mystus kapirat.)

m. (-रः)
The cocoanut tree^1.
E.
फल the fruit, and केशर hair, covered with a fibrous coat like hair.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

m. (-कः)
The scrotum or testicles.
E.
फल fruit, कोष sheath, and कन् aff. of comparison.

m. (-ष्णः)
A small fruit, (Carissa carandas.)
E.
फल fruit, and कृष्ण black.

mfn. (-हिः-हिः-हि)
Fruitful, bearing fruit in due season.
E.
फल fruit, ग्रह to take, aff. इन्, also फलेग्रहि.

m. (-ही)
A tree.
E.
फल fruit, ग्रह to take, aff. णिनि.

n. (-नं)
Disappointing.
E.
फल, and खण्डन destroying.

n. (-सं)
The bark of the Indian fig, ground and eaten with curds, by way of penance.

mfn. (-लन्-लन्ती-लत्)
Yielding fruit, profit, &c.
E.
फल to bear fruit, शतृ aff.

n. (-यं)
1 Three sorts of fruit collectively, as the fruit of the vine, the Parush, and the Gmelina arborea.
2 The three myrobalans.
E.
फल fruit, and त्रय three.

n. (-कं)
The three myrobalans collectively.
E.
फल fruit, and त्रिक three-fold.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Yielding or bearing fruit, results, &c.
m. (-दः)
A tree.
E.
फल fruit, and द what gives; also फलदातृ, फलदायिन्, &c.

n. (-नं)
Fructifying, bearing fruit, producing consequences.
E.
फल, and ल्युट् aff.

f. (-त्तिः)
Cessation of consequences.
E.
फल, and निवृत्ति stop.

f. (-त्तिः)
Final consequence or result.
E.
फल, and निर्वृत्ति completion.

f. (-त्तिः)
1 Bearing fruit.
2 Yielding profit or desired results.
E.
फल, and निष्पत्ति putting forth.

m. (-कः)
1 The ripening of fruit.
2 The fulness of consequences.
3 The Caronda.
E.
फल fruit, and पाक ripening.

f. (-न्ता)
An annual plant.
E.
फल fruit, पाक ripening or ripeness, and अन्त end; dying after bearing fruit.

n. (-नं)
Knocking down or gathering fruit.
E.
फल, and पातन felling.

m. (-च्छः)
A sort of esculent root or bulb.
E.
फल fruit, and पुच्छ a tail.

m. (-रः)
Common citron, (Citrus medica.)
E.
फल fruit, and पूर to fill, aff. क.

m. (-कः)
Common citron.
E.
कन् added to the last.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Yielding fruit, productive, yielding a reward, &c.
E.
फल, and प्रद what gives.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Connected with or producing consequences, yielding fruit, &c.
E.
फल, and प्रयुक्त applied.

f. (-प्तिः)
Obtaining the desired result or fruit.
E.
फल, and प्राप्ति acquiring.

mfn. (-भाक्)
Having or receiving fruit, consequence, &c.
E.
फल, and भाज् who shares.

f. (-मिः)
Any region not included in the known continent, as heaven, hell, &c.
E.
फल fruit, (of actions,) and भूमि earth.

m. (गः)
1 Receipt or enjoyment of consequences.
2 Possession of rent or profit, usufruct.
E.
फल, and भोग enjoyment.

m. (गः)
Non-enjoyment of profits, &c.
E.
फल, and अभोग non-use.

mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि)
Who receives the profits, consequences, &c.
E.
फल, and भोगिन् who enjoys.

f. (-का)
A sort of date.
E.
फल fruit, and मुद्गर a mallet, aff. कन् in the fem. form.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
1 Bearing fruit.
2 Yielding results, or consequences.
E.
फल fruit, and मतुप् poss. aff.

m. (-वः)
The pomegranate.
E.
फल fruit, शाड to extol, aff. अव.

mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि)
Bearing or yielding fruit.
E.
फल, and शालिन् having.

m. (-ष्ठः)
The mango.
E.
फल fruit, and श्रेष्ठ best.

m. (-सः)
The jack or bread fruit.
E.
फल fruit, सह to be able, aff. डः see पनस.

f. (-पद् or पत्)
Prosperity, success.
E.
फल, and सम्पत् abundance.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Produced in or by fruit.
E.
फल, and सम्भव born; also फलसम्भू.

n. (-नं)
Means or instrument of success.
E.
फल, and साघन means.

f. (-द्धिः)
Realising an object, reaping the fruit of any act.
E.
फल, and सिद्धि perfection.

f. (-निः)
Loss of fruit or profit.
E.
फल, and हानि abandonment.

n. (-णं)
Rate or aggregate of profits.
E.
फल, and अनुसरण conformity.

f. (-ङ्क्षा)
Hope or expectation of favourable consequences.
E.
फल, and आकाङ्क्षा desire.

m. (-नः)
A parrot.
E.
फल fruit, अदन eating.

m. (-क्षः)
A tree, commonly Khirani, (Mimusops Kauki.)
E.
फल fruit, अध्यक्ष superintendant.

m. (-न्तः)
A bambu.
E.
फल fruit or blossom, अन्त end.

f. (-क्षा)
Regard to or expectation of consequences.
E.
फल, and अपेक्षा expectation.

mfn. (तः-ता-तं)
Unproductive, unfertile.
E.
फल, and अपेत deprived.

f. (-त्)
A cricket.

m. (-नः)
A parrot.
E.
फल fruit, and अशन food.

mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि)
Living on fruits.
E.
फल, and अशिन् who eats.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
1 Doing any thing for the sake of reward.
2 Fond of or seeking to pluck fruit.
E.
फल, and आसक्त attached to.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Fruitful, bearing fruit.
2 Successful, yielding a result.
m. (-तः)
A tree.
E.
फल fruit, and इतच् aff.

mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि)
1 Bearing fruit, fruitful.
2 Productive of consequences.
m. (-ली)
1 A sort of fish, commonly Phalāi (Mystus kapirat.)
2 A tree, especially in fruit.
f. (-नी)
1 A medicinal plant, commonly

Priyangu.
2

A potherb, (Echites dichotoma.)
3 A flower, (Celosia cristata.)
E.
फल fruit, and इनि aff.

m. (-षः)
A sort of creeper.
E.
फल fruit, and ऊषन् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-हिः-हिः-हि)
Bearing fruit in season, fruitful.
E.
फल fruit, ग्रह to take, aff. इन्; ए substituted irregularly for the final of फल; also फलग्रहि and फलेग्राहिन्.

mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि)
Bearing fruit in due season.
E.
as above, णिनि aff.

f. (-हा)
The trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.)
E.
फल fruit, in the seventh case, रुह to grow, aff. क.

m. (-यः)
1 Collecting of fruits.
2 A collection of fruits.
E.
फल, and उच्चय abundance.

f. (-मा)
1 A small sort of rope.
2 The benefit arising from sacred study.
E.
फल fruit, उत्तभ best.

mfn. (त-ता-तं)
Having or yielding fruit, &c.
E.
फल, and उपेत possessing.

m. (-तिः)
The mango.
E.
फल fruit, उत् over, पति ruler.

m. (-यः)
1 Gain, profit.
2 Heaven, paradise.
3 Joy, happiness.
4 Consequence, result.
E.
फल fruit, gain, &c. उदय rising.

m. (-शः)
Regard to results.
E.
फल, and उद्देश pointing out.

m. (-निः)
Pudendum muliebre.

m. (-ल्कः)
An expanded or extended body.
E.
फल to separate, Uṇādi aff. क.

mfn. (-ल्गुः-ल्गुः-ल्गु)
1 Pithless, sapless.
2 Vain, unprofitable, unmeaning, useless.
3 Weak, feeble.
f. (-ल्गुः)
1 The opposite-leaved fig tree, (F. oppositi-folia, Rox.)
2 The name of a river which is said to run underneath

Gaya.
3

Falsehood, false or lying speech.
4 A red powder, usually of the root of wild ginger, coloured with sappan wood, and thrown over one another by the Hindus, at the Holi festival.
5 The spring season.
E.
फल to bear fruit, Uṇādi aff. गुक्

m. (-नः)
1 A name of

ARJUNA.
2

The month Phālguna.
f. (-नी)
The constellation Phalgunī.
E.
फल to bear fruit, Uṇādi aff. उनन् and गुक् aug.: see फाल्गुन.

m. (-नः)
1 A name of

ARJUNA.
2

A sort of tree, (Pentaptera Arjuna.)
3 A month, commonly called by the name Phālguna, (February-March.)
f. (-नी)
1 Day of full moon on the month Phālguna, on which the Holī or great vernal festival of the Hindus is celebrated.
2 A name common to the eleventh and twelfth lunar asterisms, distinguished by the epithets first and last, or पूर्व्व and उन्तरः see पूर्व्वफाल्गुनी, &c.

m. (-लः)
The month Phālguna.
E.
फल्गु, and अल equal to, the same.

n. (-ल्यं)
A bud, a flower.
E.
फल fruit, यत् aff.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Furrowed, ploughed.
n. (-ष्टं)
A ploughed field.
E.
फाल, and कृष्ट furrowed.

m. (-जः)
Spring.
E.
फाल्गुन the month, अनु according, and ज born.

m. (-कः)
The month Phālguna.
E.
फाल्गुनी day of full moon in this month, and ठक् aff.
